concerns.text: FR-006 (associational framing of predictive findings) is not referenced in any phase of the implementation plan. The plan should include a task (e.g., in Phase 2 or Phase 6) to ensure that all reported results are explicitly labeled as associational and that no causal language is used.

FR-007 (acknowledgement of limitation due to using only three thermodynamic descriptors) is absent from the plan. A dedicated step (perhaps in Phase 5 or Phase 6) should be added to document this limitation in the final report and discuss potential bias.
